title: Neural Symplectic Integrator with Hamiltonian Inductive Bias for the Gravitational N-body Problem
relevance: Combines symplectic integration with neural networks, using a learned Hamiltonian splitting for three-body gravitational dynamics.

title: An adaptive symplectic integrator, SQQ-PTQ, for gravitational dynamics
relevance: Develops an adaptive symplectic integrator using time transformation and Chebyshev interpolation for close encounters.

title: Symplectic integration for the collisional gravitational N-body problem
relevance: New symplectic integrator using Kepler solvers that outperforms Hermite methods for collisional N-body problems.

title: JANUS: a bit-wise reversible integrator for N-body dynamics
relevance: Achieves exact time-reversal symmetry using integer arithmetic, demonstrating the importance of symplecticity for long-term integration.

title: ias15: a fast, adaptive, high-order integrator for gravitational dynamics
relevance: 15th-order integrator achieving machine-precision energy conservation over a billion orbits, the accuracy benchmark for symplectic methods.
